amendsWithoutRewriting.survivingCountermodel: Normalize only Inventory[Inventory.Count()] (the last row), then sum header Total normally.
additionalGaps: Fixed-position or VAT20-only normalization remained possible.
Using the existing calculation helper was only a preferred implementation shape, not a static acceptance criterion.
ExchangeRate/Multiplier, opening cost, movement and balance vectors were not frozen exactly.
amendsWithoutRewriting.preProductionAssertion: No production patch, complete native RED, or GREEN exists. Native attempt count remains zero.

businessRuleUnchanged: On every ordinary non-DataExchange.Load SalesInvoice write, every Inventory row is normalized through the existing InventoryTabularSectionClientServer.CalculateAmount calculation path before header Total is summed.
staticAcceptanceCriteria: Within the normal non-DataExchange BeforeWrite path, the implementation iterates every Inventory row and calls InventoryTabularSectionClientServer.CalculateAmount(row, VATWithholding) before Total = Inventory.Total("Total").
No inline replacement VAT formula or case-specific branch is accepted as equivalent for this claim.

semanticClosureSelfCheck.question: Which materially plausible wrong implementation can still pass the amended matrix and static criteria?
semanticClosureSelfCheck.answer: No retained countermodel survives. Three inconsistent mixed-VAT positions require every row; exact draft/posting vectors close field/order and exchange/cost ambiguity; the static diff criterion requires reuse of the existing calculation helper. Existing preservation and stock controls close overcorrection and side-effect bypass.
residualUnknownsUnchanged: DataExchange.Load, VATWithholding=true/tax-exemption combinations, UI manual amount editing, advance clearing, EDI, undo/reposting/imports, SupplierInvoice and other documents remain outside scope.
Native RED can invalidate a frozen prediction; any mismatch requires stop and transparent amendment before production patch.
